download_dreambench_data: download the DreamBench dataset from HuggingFace and extract images and captions to a local directory
load_dreambench_prompts: load all DreamBench prompts from the dataset directory and return a dictionary mapping lookup keys to prompt data
load_filtered_prompts: load only specific DreamBench prompts by providing a set of required lookup keys to filter results
create_lookup_key: create a lookup key string from a prompt ID integer and category string for prompt identification
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it downloads and extracts the DreamBench dataset from HuggingFace
